name: whity-render-service
description: Server-side PDF/PNG export microservice for the whity-core document/label designer (ADR 0012). Loads the SAME React renderer the browser preview uses (web/components/documents/print-document.tsx) via headless Chromium, so exported output stays pixel-parity with the designer preview.

scripts.start: npm run build:harness && npm run build:info && node src/server.js
